candidate.raw_translation: Kila mchezaji anapata matofali saba. ya juu mara mbili katika mkono wowote inafungua; kama hakuna mkono ina mara mbili, juu ya thamani ya matofali inafungua. Kulingana na mwisho mmoja wa matofali kwa ama kufungua mwisho wa mstari. Katika draw mode, kuchukua matofali kutoka kwa hisa mpaka unaweza kucheza au ni tupu. Katika kuziba mode, kupita wakati huwezi kucheza. mzunguko kumalizika wakati mkono ni tupu au hakuna mchezaji anaweza kusonga; mchezaji na pips chache zilizobakia anashinda mzunguko kuziba.
candidate.source: Each player gets seven tiles. The highest double in either hand opens; if neither hand has a double, the highest-value tile opens. Match one end of a tile to either open end of the line. In draw mode, take tiles from the stock until you can play or it is empty. In block mode, pass when you cannot play. The round ends when a hand is empty or neither player can move; the player with fewer remaining pips wins a blocked round.
